headline_seed: Canada Retaliates With Up to 50% Tariffs on Hundreds of U.S. Products - The New York Times
draft_text:
Canada announced retaliatory tariffs on 700+ U.S. goods — steel, aluminum, dairy, electronics — set at 15%, 25% or 50%, effective September 8. AP and CNN confirm the move follows U.S. 50% tariffs on roughly $20 billion in Canadian goods.

And that's the mews.
